WSEC-001.scenario: Verify that typing the address of a module that is not live does not open it
WSEC-001.preconditions: The web app is reachable over the browser and the admin is signed in (email, password and OTP) and on the dashboard.
steps: Type the module address directly in the browser address bar, for example <app URL>/create-transfer.
Wait about one second for the page to settle.
Check what the page shows and where the browser ends up.
Repeat for each address in the test data.
WSEC-001.expected: For each address the module does not open: the page shows a blocking message (such as "cannot open", "not found", "forbidden", "no access", "unauthorized" or "access denied"), or the browser is redirected away from that address.

WSEC-006.scenario: Verify that no passwords, OTPs or full account numbers are kept in browser storage or printed to the browser console
WSEC-006.preconditions: The web app is reachable over the browser and the admin is signed in (email, password and OTP) and on the dashboard. Browser developer tools are open.
steps: Open the browser developer tools and look at everything in Local Storage and Session Storage for the app.
Search the stored values for password, otp, cvv, "pin" and for any run of 9 to 18 digits (a full account number).
Open the Console tab and keep it open.
Go to the Beneficiary List page (<app URL>/beneficiaries) and wait about one second.
Read all console messages and search them for password and otp.
WSEC-006.expected: Web storage contains no "password", "otp", "cvv" or "pin" values and no unmasked 9-18 digit account number. The console shows no message containing "password" or "otp".
